author: GoPro
description:
The '26 FWT Georgia Pro is being restaged in the Küthai, Innsbruck Austria for the third stop of the tour following the cancellation at Tetnuldi due to weather conditions. This gives the athletes the opportunity to compete for the points originally allocated to the stop. Schöffi’s Face in Kühtai starts at 8,700+ feet (2,678 meters) with a vertical drop of almost 1,500 feet (455 meters). As a completely new venue for the entire roster, Schöffi’s Face creates a level playing field for the world’s best ski and snowboard athletes.

Check out all the behind the scenes FWT action :point_right: @GoProSnow's "Off the Record" series.
